guide.title: Critical Thinking Guide
guide.subtitle: Learn how to evaluate political claims and make informed voting decisions.
guide.intro: Before believing or sharing any political information, ask yourself these questions:
guide.q1_desc: Is it from a reputable news organization, official government record, or verified fact-checker? Or is it from an anonymous social media post?
guide.q2_desc: Does the claim link to documents, data, or official records? Can you verify it independently?
guide.q3_desc: Consider who gains from you believing this information. Is someone trying to manipulate your opinion?
guide.q4_desc: Are both achievements AND failures being presented? One-sided information is often propaganda.
guide.q5_desc: Is this information recent and relevant, or is it outdated and being recycled to mislead?

about.title: About WhoToVotePH
about.mission_desc: To empower Filipino voters with factual, balanced information about national officials — presenting both achievements and controversies — so they can make informed decisions free from bias and misinformation.
about.methodology_desc: Every fact on this platform is sourced from verifiable records: news reports from reputable outlets, official government documents, legislative records, and professional fact-checking organizations.
about.nonpartisan_desc: We do not endorse, rank, or recommend any candidate or official. Every profile receives equal treatment in depth and structure. We present facts — you decide.
about.sources_desc: We rely on Philippine fact-checking organizations, official government records, and reputable news outlets.

footer.disclaimer: WhoToVotePH is a non-partisan platform. We do not endorse any candidate or political party.
